baselinePolicy: Reuse 358 selected saved Jev/OpenAI responses for the original baseline and same-gate controls; all 450 historical reader outputs reproduced exactly. After Microsoft tuning, rerun Jev/OpenAI with the same frozen request transformations and gates, as requested. Frozen API inputs and labels remain unchanged.

finalRecipe.rationale: Microsoft development selected explicit latest-turn context, clarified criteria, readable topic grading and compact exact evidence excerpts. Jev/OpenAI receive those same inputs and confidence gates without provider-specific retuning.

candidateFreeze.rule: zero development false continuations; minimum missed continuations; highest tied threshold

gradeCandidateFreeze.rule: zero development false explored credit; maximum synthetic and topic coverage checks; highest tied threshold
gradeCandidateFreeze.limitation: Selected after first validation results were seen; validation re-scoring is a regression check, not a new blind holdout. No validation cases used to choose threshold.

rules.silence: Zero development false continuations; minimum misses; highest tied threshold. Retain .85 if no candidate meets zero false continuations.
rules.explored: Zero development false explored credit; maximum synthetic/real coverage checks; highest tied threshold. Retain .85 if no candidate meets zero false credit.

foundryCandidateFreeze.limitations: Reuses a corpus already used for the prior provider comparison; this is a development-selected regression comparison, not an independent new population.

search.rule: Zero false explored credit and zero critical failures; maximize real coverage plus synthetic assertions. Prefer the unchanged native request on a primary tie, then real reading checks and highest tied threshold. Remaining ties use arm name.
search.limitation: Development selection only. Baseline validation was already inspected; subsequent validation is a regression replay, not a new untouched holdout.

foundryHillFreeze.rule: Use the selected arm for changed lanes; reuse native results only when complete transformed requests are identical. All original labels, criteria and evidence rules remain fixed.
foundryHillFreeze.limitation: Development selection only. Baseline validation was already inspected; subsequent validation is a regression replay, not a new untouched holdout.

turn.rule: Maximize development turn checks; highest tied novel threshold, retain feedback gate .8. Cases and labels remain frozen.
turn.limitation: Regression replay on previously inspected validation corpus; not an untouched holdout.

grade.rule: Zero false explored credit and zero critical failures; maximize real coverage plus synthetic assertions. Prefer the unchanged native request on a primary tie, then real reading checks and highest tied explored and satisfaction thresholds. Remaining ties use arm name.
grade.limitation: Development selection only. Baseline validation was already inspected; subsequent validation is a regression replay, not a new untouched holdout.

freshProviderFailures.reason: Native project-delivery choice not-yet has probability .42 while touched has .43; SDK rejects a selected choice that is not a highest-probability option. No response repair or replacement; failed slot retained.

limitations: Repeated cases measure stability, not independent accuracy samples.
Two related historical interview archives with finalized transcript prefixes.
Turn decisions use frozen maps and isolated one-step ranking; no live voice or full causal interview replay.
Saved baseline latency is historical; optimized Jev/OpenAI timing is contemporary, and Microsoft uses a separate Azure endpoint.
Selection used development only, but validation had already been inspected; this is a regression replay, not an untouched holdout.
Expected evidence-ID lists are not exhaustive; mismatches require semantic review.
Lower coverage gates can increase both correct coverage and false explored credit; same-gate saved controls separate this policy effect from prompt changes.
Critical assertion failures include missing outputs caused by transport/format failures; they are not all semantic model errors.
derivedArms: calibrated and improved arms reuse the named source responses, latency and usage without additional API calls.
